requested_changes.title: Negative invocation and original response identities are not bound to the frozen refusal
requested_changes.evidence: Exact selected verify_refusal accepted a correct outer refusal that referenced a negative invocation declaring foreign run, foreign task and success lane, plus original REJECTED response with same task but foreign run/lane and unrelated negative condition. Native bridge remained an actual-shaped nonzero result; only wrapping labels were current.
requested_changes.why: The implementation checks run/lane/condition on the producer-authored refusal envelope. It checks only native_exit and tool pair on the invocation, and status/task on the original response. Reusing another refusal can therefore satisfy this leaf guard.
requested_changes.requested_change: Keep R02 partial OPEN. Bind the negative invocation scope/run/product task/lane and Root input to the current frozen negative condition, then derive that same refusal from the original response; add consistently relabeled cross-run/lane/condition negatives.

requested_changes.title: Task and TaskRun content_hash NULL conflicts with the proposed decoder
requested_changes.evidence: internal/domain/store.go initializes hash to nil and sets it only for receipt_hash-bearing objects or Artifact before storing domain_objects.content_hash. Task/TaskRun do not receive a hash through that code. The decoder requires every fetched digest to be a SHA-256 string. Exact digest guard rejects revision=1,digest=None without executing SQL.
requested_changes.why: An immutable normal product Task/TaskRun snapshot cannot pass the new success/cancellation reader as written. A synthetic fixture with invented digest would conceal the public writer contract mismatch.
requested_changes.requested_change: Align Task/TaskRun decoding with the actual nullable column and public entity schema. Validate complete immutable raw snapshot and appropriate task/run identity/revision/body; do not invent a Task/TaskRun content hash.
requested_changes.current_containment: False rejection only; success/cancellation original decoders must remain OPEN pending correction and actual schema validation.

requested_changes.title: JSONL reader accepts records outside the public SessionEvent contract
requested_changes.evidence: Exact _jsonl accepted the author-style event missing event_id, command_id and domain_event_id. A second control changed kind to INVENTED and removed payload; it was still accepted. internal/domain/client_protocol_events.go declares all ten fields, rejects unknown kinds and validates payload.
requested_changes.why: Current SessionEvent checks establish only a subset of identity/cursor fields; they do not establish that the captured stream has the real public event shape. The authors positive shape control itself omits public required fields.
requested_changes.requested_change: Validate the actual published SessionEvent required/allowed field set, identifiers, kind and applicable payload type before cross-checking run state. Use a full valid public-schema frame for the positive source-data control and malformed records as negatives.
requested_changes.current_containment: Selected-leaf acceptance only; four missing semantic decoders and the unconditional dispatch guard still prevent A04 qualification.
